If critical details are missing,
ask up to 3 clarifying questions.

spans.text: At each decision point, offer exactly 3 options, one recommended first.
spans.note: The prompt strongly supports user agency through its facilitation design. It asks one question at a time, offers exactly 3 clearly described options at each decision point, accepts custom responses, shows progress, and closes with a decision summary for user review. The user retains full control over all choices.

spans.text: Keep recommendations persona-first and add business translation second.
spans.note: The prompt's design philosophy centers on persona-first language and explicitly translates business jargon into user-centric framing. The facilitation approach treats the user as the decision-maker and presents balanced options with clear reasoning, promoting inclusive and fair interaction patterns.
